description: This file defines a PHP class 'cssmin' that provides static methods for minifying CSS stylesheets, converting CSS strings to array structures, and encoding/decoding URL expressions within CSS. It also includes utility functions for array cleaning and URL encoding/decoding.

classes.name: cssmin
classes.description: A class providing static methods for CSS minification, parsing, and encoding URL expressions.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Minifies CSS content by removing comments, whitespace, and optionally last semicolons, and encodes URLs if specified.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Transforms a CSS string into a structured array representing CSS rules.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the CSS structure array back into a CSS string.
